entities.summary: Maminiaina Ravatomanga, often known as Mamy Ravatomanga, is a Malagasy businessman, owner of the Sodiat group, and close adviser to President Andry Rajoelina. He is quoted by Forbes, in 2017, as the second richest man in Madagascar, behind Ylias Akbaraly.
